decisions.reason: As a certified extension close to the core heat-exchanger business in a growing market, it is likely to be retained because the firm has already invested in development and can still justify any slow start as normal market build-up.
Management is very unlikely to withdraw a marine box cooler system that builds on the established offer and is already presented with evidence of strong market acceptance and major share.
A dedicated product page signals visible commitment, and because this marine cooling unit fits the firm’s existing capabilities and strategic direction, management would be inclined to persist.

Although only lightly featured publicly, the compact oil cooler is still close to the established portfolio, so with recent launch timing and sunk development effort management would more likely continue than abandon it.
Its own webpage and technical fit with the air-cooler business indicate meaningful commitment, making continuation likely while management waits for broader commercial traction.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage core engineering know-how and were given stand-alone visibility, so escalation of commitment makes a near-term withdrawal unlikely.
